parameter.name: hostname
parameter.label: Hostname or IP
parameter.description: Hostname or IP of the device

parameter.name: ping
parameter.label: Check device availability
parameter.description: Once per second the device answers a single "all ports" request that also refreshes port states; the device is marked OFFLINE only after several consecutive missed answers

parameter.name: timeout
parameter.label: Request timeout
parameter.description: HTTP request timeout to the device in milliseconds

parameter.name: failLimit
parameter.label: Offline threshold
parameter.description: Number of consecutive unanswered polls before the device is marked OFFLINE

parameter.name: setup
parameter.label: Auto setup
parameter.description: Openhab automatically set server settings and script according to default IP address
